title: rosa × dumetorum subsp. obtusifolia
intro: Rosa × dumetorum subsp. obtusifolia, commonly known as the sweetbrier rose, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). The sweetbrier rose is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of the plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it useful for treating various health issues such as skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of the sweetbrier rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
